reasons: Five coastal windows show lower p95 HEM sigma for GLO-30 than GLO-90.
GLO-90 changes near-threshold classifications and removes coarse water-mask cells that contain GLO-30 land, which is material for islands and narrow coasts.
Range-served classified COGs isolate the browser from raw DEM size while coastal masking and immutable blocks control delivery cost.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Lower build and storage cost does not offset measured loss of coastal detail, higher HEM percentiles, and threshold disagreement in the reviewed windows.
The accepted absolute-water-surface interval methodology still requires EGM2008 DSM terrain as Z_DSM_EGM2008.

heightError.hemSemantics: per-pixel one-sigma random error; excludes systematic, phase-unwrapping, editing, filling, and DSM representation errors
heightError.publishedAbsoluteLe90Target: less than 4 m; product-level performance, not a per-pixel uncertainty bound
heightError.editedRule: HEM sentinel requires a reviewed category/source-specific U_edit; no numeric substitution is permitted

systematicError.reason: HEM explicitly excludes systematic elevation offsets and phase-unwrapping errors; the published product-level LE90 target is not a per-pixel bound.
systematicError.rule: without independently justified U_systematic, classification is uncertain-threshold

qualityPolicy.uneditedUnfilledLand: use U_random plus required representation terms
qualityPolicy.editedOrFilledLand: uncertain-threshold until U_edit is independently bounded for the EDM/FLM category
qualityPolicy.water: WBM ocean identifies adjacency for land seeds; water pixels are never published as exposed land
qualityPolicy.unexpectedCode: DataUnavailable and fail the source contract

dsmRepresentationBias.reason: Copernicus DEM is a surface model; vegetation, buildings, infrastructure, and hydro-editing can raise or alter the represented surface relative to bare-earth terrain.
dsmRepresentationBias.rule: without an independently justified U_DSM for the surface context, classification is uncertain-threshold

resolutionRepresentation.rule: U_resolution must bound within-cell and resampling representation error using GLO-30 controls; it is never assumed zero

uncertainty.composition: U_Z=U_random+U_systematic+U_edit+U_DSM+U_resolution; absent terms do not default to zero

delivery.buildCost: GLO-30 has nine times the pixels of GLO-90 per matched window; evidence records source and lossless-class bytes
delivery.browserRule: the browser range-reads classified coastal COG blocks and never downloads or evaluates raw DEM/quality layers
mitigations: mask processing and publication to the selected Europe/coastal scope
publish lossless tiled COGs with overviews and immutable range caching
retain raw DEM and quality layers only in the offline build cache
